title: fix(app-shell): list-view nav — object page renders one switcher (ADR-0053 phase 1)
body:
Implements **phase 1** of [ADR-0053](docs/adr/0053-list-view-navigation-modes.md).

## Problem
An object's default list rendered **two** tab-like rows: the canonical `ViewTabBar` (named-view switcher) **and** an in-list Airtable-style row (`viewDef.tabs` → plugin-list `TabBar`, plus `quickFilters`/`userFilters`). Confuses *switch view* vs *filter subset*.

## Fix (runtime mutual-exclusion)
The object data-mode list is **"views" mode** — `ViewTabBar` is the only nav control. The in-list filter rows belong to page **"filters" mode** (`InterfaceListPage`, which drives `ListView` directly and is untouched). So the object `ObjectView`'s `renderListView` now suppresses `quickFilters` / `userFilters` / `tabs`.

Surgical: 3 fields in `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`.

## Verified in-browser (showcase task page)
- Before: 2 rows (`view-tab-bar` + `view-tabs`). After: **1 row** (`view-tab-bar` only).
- View switching still works (Grid / Board(Kanban) render correctly).
- `InterfaceListPage` (filters mode) path unchanged.

## Follow-ups (per ADR-0053)
- **Phase 2**: discriminated `ListNav` union + Zod `refine` + `check` rule + shared `ListNavBar` presentation (correct-by-construction for AI authoring).
- **Phase 3**: migrate the suppressed presets into named views; remove `quickFilters` / schema `tabs` / `userFilters` `toggle`.

Note: the In Progress/Urgent/Done **presets** (formerly `viewDef.tabs`) no longer show on the object page — per ADR-0053 those become named views (phase 3) or live in pages. Status filtering remains available via the toolbar Filter.
